## History

Carrie Sloane is a schoolmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She gathers with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their fellow students during a social get-together. Later, she attends school alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) under the instruction of their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
